title: Publier le correctif de visibilité adulte de l’extension
validationEvidence: Local npm run verify passes completely after the adult visibility wiring.
Local package:extension produces 1.0.34 bytes whose hashes differ from immutable production 1.0.34, proving a new version is required.
The release contract forbids overwriting an existing immutable archive.

steps.title: Prepare deterministic 1.0.35 candidate
acceptance: Source version and package archives are 1.0.35.
Chrome and Firefox archives are deterministic across two builds.
Extension, Web, Worker and documentation contracts pass.
commands: Update only the listed version and release evidence files with apply_patch.
Run npm run verify, package:extension twice, compare SHA-256 values, and validate Archify.
Review and commit the candidate without publishing provider resources.

steps.title: Publish immutable archives and advance download pointer
acceptance: A fresh bounded Cloudflare plan contains only the two 1.0.35 R2 objects and required Worker update.
Archives are uploaded before the Worker pointer update and remote hashes match.
commands: Inspect account and generate a fresh plan.
Apply only after explicit provider approval with the exact plan digest.
Verify remote HTTP, hashes, and /download, then commit and push documentation.
